description: aphrody plugin hooks. SessionStart: injects a session-level reminder steering Claude towards the native MCP docs tools. AfterAgent: runs the autonomous loop hook to force the agent to continue until DONE_SENTINEL is returned.

hooks.command: echo 'aphrody-mcp ready: 18 native tools available. For ANY library / framework / SDK / API / cloud-service question, call `mcp__aphrody__docs_auto_search` FIRST (fans out Context7 + Microsoft Learn + Google in parallel). Drill down with microsoft_docs_fetch / context7_query_docs / universal_web_fetch on a specific URL.'
